name: qfd_tile_nk_romleaf_c1-c1-COMMIT
purpose: Q-ROMPARENT c1 (opt-in REGROOT 1, zero added edges): TX roots in LSL strips (ck_tx4/5 entered from the S face up the col1/col2 channel); RQR column halves rsw/rnw (W gutter) + rse/rne (E gutter) and ROM-word/s2_w halves dw/de each own one plain rectangle beside their ROM column; ME ck in the east block. Port buffers off. Owner rule 10-16: regional roots, neighbour-relative skew; the 1.17 mm tile needs no in-tile local copy for the 2 mm broadcast limit.
